items.text: MongoDB acquired Firebolt to add a high-performance real-time analytics engine to its operational data and AI platform.
items.text_zh: MongoDB 收购 Firebolt，将高性能实时分析引擎纳入其运营数据与 AI 平台。
items.cat_take_en: The deal strengthens MongoDB’s agent-data story, but integration complexity could delay the real-time workflows customers actually want.
items.cat_take_zh: 交易强化 MongoDB 的代理数据布局，但整合复杂度可能拖慢客户真正需要的实时工作流。
